scope: isolated H2 + actual Workflow/Space Mapper, platform Menu/User reads, real WorkflowExportService and MockMVC Controller; no live Centre/Provider/browser
authenticationScope: existing fixture loginAs/login controls the principal; no full JWT/Redis/filter authentication chain
actualBodyUTF8:
flowMeta:
  name: 中文😀工作流
  description: 原说明
  avatarIcon: 原图标
  avatarColor: '#0a0a0a'
  edgeType: bezier
  category: 3
  advancedConfig: '{"flag":false}'
  dslVersion: v1
flowData:
  nodes:
  - id: node-start::s
    data:
      nodeMeta:
        nodeType: node-start
        aliasName: 开始
      inputs: [
        ]
      outputs:
      - id: q-in
        name: question
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
      nodeParam: {
        }
      label: 当前草稿
  - id: question-answer::q
    data:
      nodeMeta:
        nodeType: question-answer
        aliasName: 静态问答
      inputs:
      - id: q-bind
        name: question
        schema:
          type: string
          value:
            type: ref
            content:
              nodeId: node-start::s
              name: question
      outputs:
      - id: q-out
        name: content
        schema:
          type: string
      nodeParam:
        question: 请回答{{question}}
        answerType: direct
        timeout: '1.0'
        needReply: 'false'
        directAnswer:
          handleResponse: 'false'
          maxRetryCounts: true
        remarkVisible: 'false'
        opaqueNull: null
  - id: node-end::e
    data:
      nodeMeta:
        nodeType: node-end
        aliasName: 结束
      inputs:
      - id: answer-ref
        name: answer
        schema:
          type: string
          value:
            type: ref
            content:
              nodeId: question-answer::q
              name: content
      outputs: [
        ]
      nodeParam:
        outputMode: 1
  edges:
  - source: node-start::s
    target: question-answer::q
  - source: question-answer::q
    target: node-end::e
  viewport:
    x: 0
    y: false
    future: null
